description: Classic UO human female base. Placement, directions and projection follow ClassicUO's mobile drawing; see research/uo-conventions.md.

canvas.notes: A frame's ground origin (encoded center cx, height+cy from its top-left) lands on the anchor. The canvas is generous so deaths and weapon reaches fit. Mirroring: pixel column i -> 255 - i, joint x -> 255 - x.

blender.notes: Timeline used by the existing scenes: source frame f is keyed at Blender frame 1 + 4f. Playback timing is not inferred from the MUL files.
